newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing to climb.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks seen continuing to climb.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks are expected to open firm on Friday and continue rising, despite likely profit-taking, brokers said.
"There seems to be enough buying to keep the index moving upward, but investors are also starting to ask whether it is good to take profit now," said a trader at brokerage John Keells.
The all share index closed 10.1 points up at 773.6 points on Thursday, after breaking through the 750-point mark on Wednesday to touch a 22-month high.
Analysts say the index should go over 800 points by August, as investors buy on good growth expectations for 1997 and 1998. -- Colombo newsroom (941) 434319
